ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the line segment $AB=10\,\text{cm}$, and point C is a point on the line segment AB. If M is the midpoint of AC and $AM=2\,\text{cm}$, find the length of the line segment BC.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$, and $AM=2\,\text{cm}$, \\
thus $AC=2AM=4\,\text{cm}$, \\
since $AB=10\,\text{cm}$, \\
therefore $BC=AB-AC=\boxed{6}\,\text{cm}$.
